title: Tetris
description: Find your flow. Build, clear, repeat.
controls: Arrows move, Z/X rotate, Space hard drop, C hold, P pause. P pause · R restart.

title: Snake
description: A little longer. A little faster. One more bite.
controls: Arrows/WASD, Space pause, R restart. P pause · R restart.

title: Pong
description: Two paddles. One ball. Settle the score.
controls: W/S or Up/Down. Space to serve. P pause · R restart.

title: Space Invaders
description: Hold the line against a sky full of trouble.
controls: ←/→ or A/D move · Space shoot · P pause · R restart P pause · R restart.

title: Pac-Man
description: Chase the dots. Stay one turn ahead.
controls: Arrows/WASD move · P pause · R restart P pause · R restart.

title: Flappy Bird
description: Find your rhythm between the obstacles.
controls: Space/Click jump · P pause · R restart P pause · R restart.

title: Asteroids
description: One ship. A whole field of possibilities.
controls: ←/→ rotate · W/↑ thrust · Space shoot · P pause · R restart P pause · R restart.

title: Whack-a-Mole
description: Quick hands win. Catch them while you can.
controls: Click or tap the mole. 30 seconds to score. P pause · R restart.
